rationale: Price is sitting exactly at the session low with no sign of stabilization — the last five 1-minute candles show a steady grind lower with no bounce attempt, making a long entry high-risk at a new low. A short entry is equally unattractive because the stock has already dropped roughly 11% from yesterday's close and is deeply extended with only 56 minutes left, leaving limited reward relative to the wide spread and elevated volatility (ATR ~$0.24 on a $35 stock). With today's realized loss already negative and the broad market under significant stress, the asymmetry does not favor initiating a new position in either direction.
